goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
-ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
-webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss:38 — `.panel` relies on `margin-left: auto` to push itself right, but the `flexbox()` mixin emits legacy `display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box` whose 2009 box model ignores auto margins, so in those legacy browsers the header panel sits directly after the title instead of at the right edge; add `-webkit-box-pack: justify` / `-webkit-box-flex: 1` or drop the legacy prefixes

adjudication.rationale: In `header.scss`, `.contents` is changed to `@include flexbox()` (which emits legacy `display: -webkit-box` / `-moz-box` before modern flex) and `.panel` is changed from `float: right` to `margin-left: auto` to push it to the right. The diff does not add any legacy-box-specific alignment properties (e.g., `-webkit-box-pack` or flexing of intervening items). In browsers that interpret `display: -webkit-box`/`-moz-box` rather than modern flexbox, `margin-left: auto` may not produce the intended right alignment, so the panel can sit immediately after preceding content instead of at the right edge.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:279 — `.small-action-desc` becomes a flex item with no `flex: 1` / width, so it shrinks to content width instead of filling the row; the float-right `.small-action-buttons` now hugs the end of the text rather than aligning to the right of the row, and long messages no longer wrap consistently at container width

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `.small-action` into a flex container (`@include flexbox(); @include align-items(center);`), making `.small-action-desc` (and its siblings like buttons/avatar) flex items. `.small-action-desc` no longer has any width/flex-grow set (it even loses its previous larger left padding/margin), so under default flex sizing (`flex: 0 1 auto`) it will size to its content and not expand to fill remaining row width. That would cause any following sibling (e.g., action buttons) to sit immediately after the text instead of being pushed to the far right, and text wrapping can change compared to a full-width block in a non-flex layout.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:280 — Removing the `0.5em` vertical padding and `margin-top: 5px` from `.small-action-desc` means multi-line custom messages taller than the avatar sit flush against the `.small-action` top/bottom borders; vertical centering only helps in the single-line case

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes `.small-action-desc` vertical spacing (`padding: 0.5em 0 ...` and `margin-top: 5px`) and replaces it with `padding: 0 1.5%` while making `.small-action` a flex container with `align-items(center)`. Flex centering does not add top/bottom padding; for multi-line content where `.small-action-desc` determines the container height, the text block itself won’t be vertically centered/padded and can end up touching the container’s top/bottom edges (depending on surrounding border/padding not shown). This is a plausible layout regression directly tied to the change, though full verification depends on other styles.

adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces float-based header/post layouts with custom flexbox mixins that emit legacy `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` declarations (`@mixin flexbox`, `inline-flex`, `order`, `align-items`). In `header.scss`, `.panel` is now right-aligned via `margin-left: auto` plus `@include order(3)`, which may not behave the same under legacy `-webkit-box` implementations as modern flexbox. Similarly, `.small-action` becomes a flex container and padding/margins are changed for `.small-action-desc` and nested `p`, which could affect wrapping/multi-line messages and any adjacent controls. These are diff-grounded behavioral changes where cross-browser/edge-case verification (e.g., screenshots/manual check) is a reasonable request, even though the diff itself can’t show whether the PR included such verification.
